notes: Cross-sectional design inferred from the household-interview survey; none is named. No test or survey weighting is stated, so no procedures are recorded. The sex contrast within each age group is read as stratified.
view_issues: Figure description calls the survey the 'National Health Interview System'. Claims ('more likely', 'decreased with age') rest on no stated test; only CI error bars are shown.
